summary: Regression retest after low-impact code-review pass: LoadingCard skeleton key changed from array-index to `skeleton-${i}` (no structural change), and dead `import httpx` lines removed from 3 test files. Re-ran full backend suite (same 80/83 pass, 3 pre-existing unrelated failures carried from iterations 19-23) and all 7 named iteration_24 print-tags/legacy-preview browser checks (all pass unchanged). Also re-ran the two browser checks that exercise LoadingCard on Finds/Inventory: finds-filters-and-legacy-inventory-route passed cleanly (Finds page, skeleton-then-populate flow, no console errors); inventory-loads-with-stats-and-items failed on both the first run and a rerun, but this is PRE-EXISTING stale-selector drift documented since iteration 14 (script expects `item-photo-slot`, an Appraise-page-only testid, right after login — a leftover from before the Home-landing redesign shipped many iterations ago) and is unrelated to the LoadingCard key change or the httpx import removals in this diff. No new regressions introduced by this change.

checks.evidence: Failed twice (not flaky): `expect(getByTestId('item-photo-slot')).toBeVisible()` times out right after SarahTest/master login, before the script ever reaches the Inventory page or stats/skeleton assertions. Screenshot confirms the app correctly renders the Home landing page (search bar, Capture Studio card) post-login — 'item-photo-slot' is an Appraise.tsx-only testid, a stale assumption from before the Home-landing redesign. This exact root cause and exact check name were already documented as failing in iteration_14.json (17 checks with the same stale-selector class). Unrelated to the LoadingCard key change or httpx import removals in this diff; no code evidence of a new regression on Inventory's skeleton/list render.

action_items.detail: Backend: same 3 pre-existing failures as iteration_24 (missing /tmp/item.jpg live-model fixture for 2 appraise tests; Chiswick High Road needs_zone_review seed-flag residue giving 15 shops instead of 14). Unrelated to this iteration's diff.

inventory-loads-with-stats-and-items browser check has a stale `item-photo-slot` selector assuming post-login landing is /appraise; this predates the Home-landing redesign and was already flagged in iteration_14.json alongside 16 sibling checks. It did not newly break from the LoadingCard key change or httpx-import removal in this diff -- the failure point (login redirect target) is upstream of any LoadingCard render. Recommend the check be rewritten to land-assert on Home and then navigate to Inventory via nav-inventory, same pattern as the now-passing finds-filters-and-legacy-inventory-route check, in a future iteration (out of scope for this strictly-regression pass).
